technical_and_design_decisions: For U1: Use Spring's dependency injection and configuration properties to allow custom encoder/decoder classes to be specified and injected into Kafka components.
For U2: Implement the gpfdist sink as a standalone Spring XD module with Java API integration for GPDB/HAWQ, following existing module patterns.
For U3: Set up UI infrastructure by leveraging existing Spring XD admin UI framework, integrating build tools for frontend asset management, and ensuring compatibility with Flo.
For U4: Create a self-contained Kafka producer-consumer module in Spring XD to demonstrate end-to-end data flow, including configuration and testing.
For U5: Adopt a Spring Batch Tasklet approach with NIO file channels for efficient file reading, avoiding line-by-line processing and excessive memory usage.
For U6: Develop a gpload tasklet that utilizes gpload utility commands or JDBC for bulk data ingestion into GPDB, with error handling and logging.
For U7: Refactor Maven dependencies to make Hadoop libraries optional via profiles and classpath exclusions, ensuring core functionality remains intact.
For U8: Implement a dynamic classpath resolver in Spring XD's module loading mechanism to support module-specific paths and property-based configurations.
assumptions: The development environment includes access to Spring XD source code, build tools (e.g., Maven), and necessary libraries.
I have adequate knowledge of Spring Framework, Spring XD, Kafka, GPDB/HAWQ, and Java development practices.
Testing frameworks (e.g., JUnit, Mockito) are available and will be used for unit and integration testing, with effort included in estimates.
User stories are independent and can be implemented without significant external dependencies or delays.
No major changes to core Spring Framework are needed; all work is confined to Spring XD modules and extensions.
Estimated efforts account for coding, configuration, basic documentation, and unit testing, but not extensive performance optimization or production deployment.

activities.activity_description: Design and implement configurable encoder and decoder interfaces for Kafka source, sink, and bus, with default implementations and Spring configuration support.
Develop a new OOTB gpfdist sink module for Spring XD, including Java code for GPDB connectivity, configuration options, and integration tests.
Set up frontend build infrastructure for admin_ui and Flo, including tooling for asset compilation, dependency management, and initial integration points.
Create an end-to-end Kafka use-case module in Spring XD, demonstrating data flow from producer to consumer, with documentation for study and verification.
Evaluate and implement a file reading tasklet using NIO for efficient, non-memory-intensive processing, comparing with stream-based approaches.
Develop a gpload tasklet for Spring XD to efficiently ingest data into GPDB, including command execution, error handling, and configuration.
Refactor project dependencies to remove Hadoop libraries from root classpath, using Maven profiles or optional dependencies to decouple when not needed.
Implement dynamic classpath resolution for modules, supporting module options and properties to load dependencies from specified locations.
